panels.title: System
panels.description: Name, version and processor of each computer.

panels.title: Load
panels.description: Threads ready to run, averaged. The main thread is not counted.

panels.title: Cores busy
panels.description: The main core runs the desktop and all threads. Helper cores only draw and copy in parallel.

panels.title: Sleep states
panels.description: Share of each second the processor spent in each sleep state. Deeper states save more power.

panels.title: Time off at last check
panels.description: How far the clock was off at the last check against the time server.

panels.title: Disk busy
panels.description: Share of time spent waiting for each kind of disk.

panels.title: Wi-Fi repeats
panels.description: Share of frames the access point had to send again. High means a poor radio link.

panels.title: Busiest windows and threads
panels.description: Share of one core. Appears after someone signs in.

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: How long building the metrics takes.
